newsitem.title: UK: Pearson unit buys UK music magazines.
newsitem.headline: Pearson unit buys UK music magazines.

text.p: Pearson's Future Publishing said on Wednesday it had purchased seven UK magazine titles and two exhibitions from Music Maker for a seven figure sum.
The deal, the exact size of which was not disclosed, confirms Future as Europe's largest publisher of musical instrument magazines.
"The deal gives us clear dominance of a lovely magazine market. It's bang up our street: active young male users of electronic equipment," said Future managing director Greg Ingham.
The acquisition includes titles such as "Guitar Techniques' and "Hip Hop Connection' plus exhibitions The London Music Fair and the National Guitar Show.

Bath-based Future Publishing, acquired by Pearson for 52.5 million stg in 1994, is the UK's fifth largest magazine publisher. It has a portfolio of 38 titles covering subjects ranging from computing to sports and entertainment.
